images.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a polished educational illustration for an enterprise architecture website. Match the attached reference's warm ivory paper, dark teal headings, teal and muted orange accents, finely drawn dimensional objects, elegant readable typography and restrained dotted connectors. Landscape 16:9, high resolution, large labels, generous space. Software intelligence must be shown as an AI chip or software window, NEVER a pump, motor or human brain. No logos, no em dashes. Reference is style only. Title: "From a business goal to a confirmed result". Simple left-to-right flow of four large illustrated stations, each with short heading and sublabel: "Business goal" / "An owner defines success" (person with inspection request); "Agent" / "Intelligence + memory" (software workspace containing an AI chip and linked evidence cards); "Permission check" / "Rules before action" (separate gate); "Enterprise systems" / "Tools perform the work" (work order software and records). Arrows join stations. Below final station a clear receipt "Confirmed result". A thin return arrow from result to agent labeled "Check the outcome". Bottom full-width quiet strip "People oversee the work • Independent records show what happened". No other text. Keep wonderfully simple and immediately understandable.
